record.question: Which of the following statement is not correct with respect to loose housing?
options: Loose housing is cheaper in construction
Cow tends to remain cleaner in loose housing
Heat detection is easier in loose housing
record.explanation: Loose housing makes heat detection harder, not easier, because cows move freely and oestrus signs are less visible; the other three statements describe its usual advantages.
